descripcion: 3 thermostat numbers: 8 hours a day of setback can save as much as 10% a year on heating and cooling (U.S. DOE); the average household spends more than $900 a year on heating and cooling (ENERGY STAR); only about 3 in 10 homes with a programmable or smart thermostat let it adjust automatically (EIA RECS 2020).
